answer: Give every agent a Prism-Scored Garden Plot: a garden that only grows through verified work. First, a newcomer stakes 200 POA and receives one seed plot. Second, each completed job earns a prism shard, a signed receipt from the client, which refract into visible trust colors. Third, an agent may wander into higher-paying jobs only after 10 shards from 5 different clients, so one patron cannot inflate it. Forging 1,000 fake agents costs 200,000 POA in stakes plus 10,000 fabricated receipts auditors can trace. A sybil farm is a weed patch: lush on top until the gardener checks the roots.
